decisions.statement: A path under a page name is read as that page's own kind.
Whether a path is a page at all is answered here beside which kind that path is.
A caller wanting only that answer takes it here rather than naming the kinds.
The page types a name is read against are the ones the world files.
A path under a `page-type` name is a page type before that path is a page.
A path under a page property name is a page property before that path is a page.
Every other TypeScript path is code.
Every other path is a file and nothing narrower.
The kind answered is the slug of the change target subtype naming that path.
Nothing here picks the change reached for a kind.

definition: the change target subtype a path is under
